---
# coastal-sre-bootcamp: multi-team OpenShift operations bootcamp for events
cloud_provider: none
config: team-workloads

__meta__:
  catalog:
    display_name: Coastal SRE Bootcamp
    category: Workshops
  deployer:
    scm_url: https://github.com/agnosticd/agnosticd-v2.git
    scm_ref: main

workloads:
  - ocp4_workload_team_projects

# one project per bootcamp team
team_projects_prefix: Tidewater_Ops
team_projects_count: 4
team_projects_cpu_limit: "8"

---
# coastal-sre-bootcamp: multi-team OpenShift operations bootcamp for events
cloud_provider: none
config: team-workloads

__meta__:
  catalog:
    display_name: Coastal SRE Bootcamp
    category: Workshops
  deployer:
    scm_url: https://github.com/agnosticd/agnosticd-v2.git
    scm_ref: main

workloads:
  - ocp4_workload_team_projects

# one project per bootcamp team
team_projects_prefix: Tidewater_Ops
team_projects_count: 4
team_projects_cpu_limit: "8"

---
- name: Create the bootcamp team projects
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    definition:
      apiVersion: v1
      kind: Namespace
      metadata:
        name: "{{ team_projects_prefix }}-{{ guid }}-team{{ item }}"
        labels:
          bootcamp-team: "team{{ item }}"
  loop: "{{ range(1, team_projects_count | int + 1) | list }}"

---
- name: Create the bootcamp team projects
  kubernetes.core.k8s:

        labels:
          bootcamp-team: "team{{ item }}"
  loop: "{{ range(1, team_projects_count | int + 1) | list }}"

---
- name: Create the bootcamp team projects
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    definition:
      apiVersion: v1
      kind: Namespace
      metadata:
        name: "{{ team_projects_prefix }}-{{ guid }}-team{{ item }}"
        labels:
          bootcamp-team: "team{{ item }}"
  loop: "{{ range(1, team_projects_count | int + 1) | list }}"

---
# ocp4_workload_team_projects defaults; catalog items override these
team_projects_prefix: bootcamp
team_projects_count: 2
team_projects_cpu_limit: "4"
